### Two Things God Remembers about His Servants
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/two-things-god-remembers-about-his-servants-today-s-insight-december-13-2018.html
Passage: Hebrews 6:10
Points:
- God is faithful and consistently just, never forgetting the service rendered to Him.
- He keeps track of every individual act of kindness done toward other believers.
- He observes and values the heart's loving motivation behind each good work.
- While people frequently overlook or forget good deeds, God is the perfect record keeper.
- Remembering God's justice encourages weary servants to remain diligent rather than sluggish.

### Will Graham Devotion: Are You Growing in Your Faith?
Author: Will Graham
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/articles/will-graham-devotion-are-you-growing-in-your-faith
Passage: Hebrews 6:1-3
Points:
- Christian maturity requires actively progressing beyond basic spiritual elementary truths.
- Believers must deliberately build upward on the foundation that has already been laid.
- Spiritual growth calls for personal resolve and intentional effort to mature.
- Believers remain entirely dependent upon God's permission and enabling power to grow.
- Purposefully seeking deeper faith protects Christians from sliding into spiritual laziness.
